legal_question: Does animal sacrifice at Dargah constitute an essential religious practice protected under Art 25?
relevant_judgment: Sardar Syedna Taher Saifuddin (AIR 1962 SC 853); Madras HC 2025
judicial_interpretation: Animal sacrifice is not an essential religious practice of Islam; subject to public order, health, and AMASR statutory bans.

legal_question: Does Dargah denominational autonomy allow non-permitted construction or rituals on protected monument land?
relevant_judgment: Dr. M. Ismail Faruqui v. UOI (1994 6 SCC 360); Madras HC 2025
judicial_interpretation: Religious denominational rights are subject to statutory monument conservation and civil court title decrees.

legal_question: Does restricting animal sacrifice while permitting Santhanakoodu festival violate equal protection?
relevant_judgment: Mohd. Hanif Quareshi v. State of Bihar (AIR 1958 SC 731)
judicial_interpretation: Uniform application of AMASR Rule 8 across all communities on protected monument land does not violate Article 14.

constitutional_provision: Protection of Language, Script and Culture
legal_question: Does renaming historic hill or defacing Jain/Hindu epigraphs violate cultural preservation rights?
relevant_judgment: Madras High Court Division Bench Order
judicial_interpretation: Affirmed historic name Thiruparankundram Hill; protected Tamil-Brahmi and epigraphic heritage under Art 29.

legal_question: Can administrative peace committees override a 1931 Privy Council decree settling civil land title?
relevant_judgment: Sub Court O.S. 4/1920; Privy Council 1931 (Pre-Art 300A title benchmark); Madras HC 2025
judicial_interpretation: Civil court title decree affirmed by Privy Council constitutes res judicata; executive orders cannot alter property boundaries protected under Art 300A principles.

legal_question: Does the Places of Worship Act apply to Thiruparankundram Hill monument grounds?
relevant_judgment: Section 4(3)(a) Places of Worship Act 1991; Madras HC 2025
judicial_interpretation: Section 4(3)(a) explicitly excludes ancient & historical monuments covered under AMASR Act 1958; AMASR statutory rules govern protected monument boundaries.

legal_question: Is cooking food or sacrificing animals permissible within ASI Protected Monument boundaries?
relevant_judgment: Madras High Court Division Bench Order
judicial_interpretation: Rule 8 strictly prohibits bringing live animals, slaughtering, or cooking within 172.70 acres of ASI protected monument area.
